text:
rachel-docs: quick heads-up  I opened a small PR to normalize our Console observability snippets and update a broken presets anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9842 — the dashboard example still says `trace_key` and the Node/Python snippets show `estimated_cost` (no currency).
pete-eng: thanks. can you list affected files so I can patch the Go snippet too?
rachel-docs: files: /docs/console/observability/overview.md, /docs/console/examples/tracehook.md, and the quickstart playground example. Also the screenshot caption reads "Cost by tracekey" which we should change.
noor-ml: runtime emits `traceId` and `estimated_cost_usd` now. we kept compat but docs should show the new shape. add a tiny migration note explaining legacy vs. current fields and where telemetry.v1 nests metrics.
alex-sdk: i'll update Node + Python snippets in the PR branch. Proposed Node helper: ````js
// prefer new fields, fall back to legacy
const id = payload.traceId || payload.trace_key
const cost = payload.estimated_cost_usd || payload.estimated_cost || payload.cost_usd
tracehook.record({ traceId: id, estimated_cost_usd: cost })
````
lina-ux: UX note: change caption to exact string "Cost by trace ID" (sentence case). If we change UI copy in screenshots, include the exact text in the caption so PMs can copy it.
link-bot: Found: presets anchor -> 404. Suggest replacing with /docs/console/presets.
petes-eng: pushed Go struct + snippet fix and updated screenshot alt text.
ci-bot: link-check for PR #9842: 1 failed (presets anchor).
rachel-docs: replaced anchor with canonical presets URL and added a 1-paragraph migration note. Pushed.
ci-bot: PR #9842 checks: links passed, sample lint passed.
alex-sdk: SDK snippet follow-up pushed. Keeping examples minimal.
rachel-docs: merged. dropping a follow-up to mirror the cookbook note in the quickstart if anyone wants to take it on. :thumbsup:
